title: ChatGPT for iOS 1.2026.202 - Voice and Visualization Improvements
description: Voice conversations now use selected ChatGPT voice with usage-limit warnings, improved task reconnection, Composer autocomplete enhancements, selected-text references preservation, improved goal controls, reliable inline table visualizations, and more responsive large workspace diffs.

title: Grok 4.5 Now Available in GitHub Copilot
description: Grok 4.5 model is now available in GitHub Copilot, expanding the available AI model options for developers.

title: Cursor Start - India-Specific Pricing Plan
description: New ₹649 monthly plan for developers in India with local pricing, UPI payment options, access to Grok 4.5 and Composer models, cloud agents, iOS support with remote control, and extension capabilities through plugins and MCP servers.

title: Dependabot Alerts on Malicious Packages Across More Ecosystems
description: Dependabot now alerts on malicious packages across additional ecosystems, improving security coverage for developers.

title: GitHub Actions Holds Potentially Malicious Workflows for Approval
description: GitHub Actions now holds potentially malicious workflows for approval, enhancing security by allowing manual review before execution.

title: Redesigned Model Picker and Slash Commands
description: Redesigned model picker with single organized menu, slash commands in message box (/btw, /queue, /ask), playbook previews on hover, and Windows sessions from Slack via !windows command.

title: GitHub Copilot for JetBrains Adds Improved OpenTelemetry Configuration and Model Management
description: GitHub Copilot for JetBrains now includes improved OpenTelemetry configuration and model management capabilities for better observability and control.

title: Manage GitHub Copilot App Access with a Dedicated Policy
description: New policy allows organizations to manage GitHub Copilot app access with dedicated controls.

title: Enterprise Managed Settings in GitHub Copilot App and Copilot Cloud Agent
description: Enterprise managed settings now apply to the GitHub Copilot app and Copilot cloud agent, providing better governance for organizations.

title: ChatGPT Voice and Multi-Folder Projects (v26.715)
description: Voice mode powered by GPT-Live for coordinating tasks in ChatGPT desktop, plus support for local projects that can include multiple related folders with primary folder designation.

community_feedback.quote: ChatGPT just quietly became a full coding machine. Everything Codex can do now lives right inside the ChatGPT desktop app.

title: Claude Opus 5 Now Available in GitHub Copilot
description: Claude Opus 5 model is now available in GitHub Copilot, expanding the available AI model options for developers.

title: Copilot Cloud Agent for Linear Generally Available
description: Copilot cloud agent for Linear is now generally available, enabling AI-powered task management for Linear workflows.

title: GitHub MCP Server Supports Next MCP Specification
description: GitHub MCP Server now supports the next MCP specification, enabling improved integration with the Model Context Protocol ecosystem.

title: Paginated Thread History and Bedrock Support (v0.145.0)
description: Experimental paginated thread history with efficient search, expanded import migration from Cursor and Claude Code, Amazon Bedrock login support, audio inputs capability, and stabilized multi-agent V2 experience.

title: Smarter Linear Thread Handling and Devin Outposts
description: Smarter Linear thread handling routing replies correctly, automations consumption visibility showing ACUs per session, Slack channel improvements for automations, safer MCP access changes, and Devin Outposts introduced for running workloads in your environment.

community_feedback.quote: Devin AI Has Come a Long Way
We tested Devin on 20 tasks and it was a colossal failure

title: Cursor Router Auto Mode
description: Auto mode now powered by Cursor Router, which analyzes requests and routes them to appropriate models. Offers three optimization modes: Intelligence (frontier quality), Balance (strong quality), and Cost (optimized token spend). Admin controls enable per-team/group enablement and model restrictions.

community_feedback.quote: Cursor Auto mode has improved drastically but lacks in memory and learning from mistakes
Auto Intelligence mode delivers output at ~60% lower cost for teams while matching frontier model quality

title: New Copilot Usage Metrics Impact Dashboard
description: New dashboard provides visibility into Copilot usage metrics and impact, helping organizations track adoption and value.

title: Gemini 3.6 Flash Now Available in GitHub Copilot
description: Gemini 3.6 Flash model is now available in GitHub Copilot, providing faster response times for certain tasks.

title: Devin Desktop v3.5.17 and Performance Improvements
description: Adds @-mention pills in Cascade with type-specific icons, restyled command palette, and instant worktree-backed sessions. Long sessions now render, scroll, and type faster while staying responsive. Customizations span all open workspace folders with Fast Context support.

title: AI Credit Pools for Cost Centers in Billing UI
description: AI credit pools can now be configured for cost centers in the billing UI, providing better cost allocation and management.

title: Copilot Users Can Now See AI Credits Used Per Billing Cycle
description: Copilot users can now view AI credits used per billing cycle, providing transparency into consumption.

title: GitHub Code Quality Generally Available
description: GitHub Code Quality is now generally available, providing automated code quality analysis and suggestions.

title: Repository-Level GitHub Copilot Usage Metrics Generally Available
description: Repository-level GitHub Copilot usage metrics are now generally available, providing granular visibility into Copilot adoption and impact.

title: Slack Integration Improvements
description: Cursor in Slack now provides planning before execution, multi-repo environment support with access to all relevant codebases, and cross-channel functionality. Interaction refinements include status updates and cleaner rendering of tables, PRs, and artifacts.

title: Centralized Skill Management and Enterprise Plugin Governance
description: Centralized skill management via plugins, enterprise-grade plugin governance, multi-repository code scans, chained attack paths linking related findings, and revamped automations editor.

title: Artifacts with MCP Connectors and Screen Reader Mode
description: Published artifacts can now pull live data and take actions through each viewer's own MCP connectors. Added screen reader mode that replaces visual terminal with plain text, /fork command for background sessions, and editor roles on Team/Enterprise.

community_feedback.quote: The MCP-to-task-app pattern is going to slowly eat every standalone 'AI productivity' app
Update this week (July 20/21, 2026) broke the MCP connections

title: GitHub Copilot App Now Available in Usage Metrics API
description: GitHub Copilot app is now available in the usage metrics API, enabling programmatic access to usage data.

title: Copilot Code Review: Customization and Configurability Improvements
description: Copilot code review now includes improved customization and configurability options, allowing teams to tailor the review experience.

title: Advanced Search for Projects Generally Available
description: Advanced search for Projects is now generally available, providing powerful search capabilities across GitHub Projects.

title: Repository Admins Can Archive Pull Requests
description: Repository admins can now archive pull requests, providing better organization and cleanup capabilities.

title: Copilot Agents Feature
description: New Copilot Agents feature allows autonomous agent execution with support for models like Copilot, Claude by Anthropic, and OpenAI Codex.

title: Quote Text Feature and Session T-Shirt Sizes
description: Quote text feature for referencing from files/worklog, filter sessions by skill, and session t-shirt sizes now based solely on ACU consumption.

title: Continue.dev Acquired by Cursor - Shutdown Announcement
description: Continue has been acquired by Cursor. Users must export their data before July 15, 2026 as all cloud data will be permanently deleted after this date. The open-source codebase remains freely available.

community_feedback.quote: Continue.dev has been acquired by Cursor. No download button, no sign-up, no roadmap.
Concerns about 'buying and shutting down open source projects'
Continue was an open-source AI coding assistant with 34,000 GitHub stars

title: Improvements to Secret Scanning and Public Monitoring
description: Improvements to secret scanning and public monitoring enhance security capabilities for repositories.
